title: Navimower 0.4.6-beta7

## Fresh-install retained-trail fetch guard and Prepared Live copy reduction

This beta follows the 0.4.6-beta6 field diagnostics.

Beta6 confirmed that persisted restart recovery can recover only the vendor trail suffix missed while Home Assistant was down. The same diagnostics also showed that Prepared Live rendering was still requesting a complete active History session snapshot for every full live build.

### Fresh installs no longer download pre-install retained trail geometry

For a genuinely fresh Navimower installation, the integration now filters the zone list before calling `/vehicle/trail/get-path-info-data-compress`.

- The normal lightweight `get-path-info-time` coverage metadata is used to determine the current zone-cycle start time.
- A zone whose cycle started before the integration's persisted tracking checkpoint is omitted from the compressed retained-trail request.
- A zone with missing/ambiguous cycle-start metadata is also omitted conservatively.
- Once a zone starts a new cycle at or after the install checkpoint, it becomes eligible for normal retained-trail polling.
- Existing beta6 install baselines remain fetchable after upgrade so their already-established restart-recovery contract is preserved.
- Existing pre-beta6 installations remain unrestricted and keep all retained geometry.

This means a new install does not first download a potentially very large pre-existing vendor route only to discard it afterwards.

For a pre-install cycle that is still in progress, Navimower records new MQTT route samples from installation time onward. Vendor retained-trail recovery begins normally with the first cycle that starts after installation.

### Prepared Live no longer requests a complete active-session object

Prepared Live rendering now uses a dedicated minimal History render snapshot containing only:

- session id / active state;
- route points;
- segment-start markers.

It no longer calls the compatibility `history.active_session` accessor and no longer deep-copies that already-copied full session a second time.

The operation still runs in the executor and the existing legacy route/render contracts are unchanged.

### Diagnostics

History active-session diagnostics now include a separate `render_snapshots` timing/count block.

Vendor trail recovery diagnostics also expose:

- candidate zone count for the latest retained-trail decision;
- requested zone count;
- number of zones blocked because they belong to a pre-install/unknown cycle.

No route coordinates or vendor raw payloads are added to Download diagnostics.

### Compatibility

- Existing installations are not treated as fresh installs.
- Existing beta6 baselines remain valid.
- Restart suffix recovery is unchanged for established vendor-owned cycles.
- No changes to mower commands, Schedule, Resume, Gate, zone progress or Prepared History archive format.
